scientific_question: Can image-label MIL over class-agnostic SAM proposal bags use frozen RAD-DINO mask/context descriptors to close the large selection gap, especially for small bone tumors, without learning another unconstrained pixel shortcut?
hypothesis: The frozen flip-TTA proposal gallery already contains masks whose GT-oracle mean exceeds every operational subgroup goal, but the hand-written selector is far below that oracle. Restricting spatial predictions to proposal shapes while learning proposal semantics from positive and normal image bags can improve selection without segmentation supervision.

allowed_training_inputs: frozen SAM ViT-B weights used only for class-agnostic mask proposals
frozen RAD-DINO weights and layers 4, 8 and 12 spatial tokens
forbidden_training_inputs: BTXRD masks, polygons, boxes, points, lesion area or subgroup identity
validation or test images in optimizer updates
validation GT for candidate generation, epoch selection, loss weighting, thresholding or routing
test images, labels, predictions or metrics
supervision_contract.validation_image_labels: used for image-level AUROC and MIL provenance only; no segmentation annotation is available before freeze
supervision_contract.validation_gt_boundary: a separate evaluator may construct the segmentation dataset only after candidate manifests, checkpoint, all 371 prediction maps, map hashes, prediction manifest and prediction_freeze.json are verified
supervision_contract.normal_candidate_semantics: tumor-targeted candidates on image-level-normal images are reliable negative MIL instances only; the ordinary saved pseudo mask for every normal image is forced empty

promoted_flip_tta_baseline.method: binary LayerCAM plus horizontal-flip TTA, coverage-mass SAM selector

candidate_generation.positive_gallery_invariance: same promoted flip-TTA LayerCAM/SAM recipe; no external saliency source
candidate_generation.normal_gallery: same tumor-class CAM/SAM recipe retained only as negative bag instances
candidate_generation.maximum_evidence: the frozen promoted validation manifest has maximum sam_candidate_count 81, reached by 21/371 images
candidate_generation.overflow_behavior: fail closed; no truncation or candidate ranking
candidate_generation.empty_bag_fallback: deterministic prompt-map p90 support; if still empty, centered half-image rectangle
candidate_generation.fallback_reporting: record every fallback bag count separately for train and validation

frozen_prior_feasibility_evidence.role: protocol-design support only; not a valid prediction result
frozen_prior_feasibility_evidence.oracle_definition: post-freeze GT selects the best raw SAM candidate independently for each positive image
frozen_prior_feasibility_evidence.interpretation: the old deployable selector fails the operational goals; only the inaccessible GT oracle exceeds them, demonstrating proposal support and selector headroom

projection.method: seed-42 Gaussian 768-to-128 projection followed by per-token L2 normalization

mask_bag_model.scorer: LayerNorm(1156), Linear(1156,256), GELU, Dropout(0.10), Linear(256,128), GELU, Linear(128,1)
mask_bag_model.bag_pool: candidate LogSumExp normalized by valid candidate count, temperature 0.20

loss.self_guided_rule: all normal-bag candidates negative; only the detached positive-bag argmax positive; other positive candidates ignored

prediction.candidate_score_tta: arithmetic mean of original and spatially aligned horizontal-flip logits for the same frozen candidate
prediction.bag_probability: same normalized LogSumExp pool applied after candidate-logit TTA
prediction.spatial_map: winner-take-all frozen SAM proposal multiplied by bag probability
prediction.threshold_for_selected_shape_evaluation: >0, which exactly recovers the selected binary proposal
prediction.normal_images: not forced empty in model predictions; image AUROC measures separation

required_before_gt: candidate input manifest and physical payload hashes

evaluation.cohort: all 371 predictions; localization metrics on all 184 positives including complete misses
metrics: image-level AUROC over all 371 bag probabilities
selected-proposal Dice overall and by fixed size subgroup
per-tumor pixel AP and pixel AUROC
raw candidate oracle as a support diagnostic
evaluation.comparison: candidate minus promoted flip-TTA baseline per-image Dice
evaluation.bootstrap: paired complete-group bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed family 20261001

relative_requirements.mean_selected_dice_delta: >=0 separately for small, medium and large
relative_requirements.complete_misses: no increase overall or in any subgroup

predeclared_gate.pass_action: authorize only design of a separate predeclared pseudo-mask consumer; do not train it automatically
predeclared_gate.fail_action: reject the exact mask-bag configuration without post-GT loss, epoch, threshold, candidate or gate tuning

relation_to_operational_goal.interpretation: passing this selector gate is intermediate evidence, not a claim that the final WSSS goal has been achieved

literature_basis.citation: Seibold et al., Self-Guided Multiple Instance Learning for Weakly Supervised Thoracic Disease Classification and Localization in Chest Radiographs, ACCV 2020
literature_basis.not_transferred: its network architecture and dataset-specific settings

literature_basis.citation: Shen et al., Toward Joint Thing-and-Stuff Mining for Weakly Supervised Panoptic Segmentation, CVPR 2021
literature_basis.transferred: MoIPool principle of MIL descriptors over arbitrary-shaped masks
literature_basis.not_transferred: panoptic branches or automatic consumer self-training

literature_basis.citation: Yang and Gong, Foundation Model Assisted Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation, WACV 2024
literature_basis.transferred: SAM as boundary-aware proposal geometry under image labels
literature_basis.not_transferred: CLIP prompt learning or direct pseudo-label consumer training

literature_basis.citation: Liu et al., Weakly-supervised High-resolution Segmentation of Mammography Images for Breast Cancer Diagnosis, PMLR 143, 2021
literature_basis.transferred: separate coarse candidate localization from fine feature analysis for small lesions
literature_basis.not_transferred: mammography architecture and its dataset-tuned settings

literature_basis.citation: Mun et al., Small Objects Matters in Weakly-Supervised Semantic Segmentation, WACV 2024
literature_basis.transferred: explicit small-object audit and preservation of fractional mask support
literature_basis.not_transferred: natural-image size labels or segmentation supervision

runtime_contract.real_device_preflight: one nontrivial CUDA convolution must succeed on each T4
runtime_contract.monitor: exactly one heartbeat after launch; interval five minutes; no polling between heartbeats

execution_order: Verify protocol, exact source commit/hashes, split, classifier, SAM, RAD-DINO and baseline direct mounts
Prove two real T4 devices and run focused plus full tests before candidate generation
Generate and freeze complete train and validation candidate galleries without segmentation GT
Verify all candidate payload hashes and cohort counts before optimizer construction
Train 16 final-epoch-only epochs and freeze all 371 validation predictions without segmentation GT
Verify every prediction/candidate/baseline hash before importing the segmentation dataset
Evaluate all fixed metrics and the all-checks-required gate with 10000 paired complete-group bootstrap replicates
Keep consumer and test locked regardless of a failed gate; a pass authorizes protocol design only
forbidden: GT-oracle candidate selection as a deployable result
candidate truncation, subgroup routing or size-dependent selection
post-GT epoch, loss, threshold, proposal, morphology or gate tuning
dropping complete misses or changing the frozen cohort/group IDs
